text: Its gone 2am and im sat with my grandson Tomas, 8. temp was 38.8 last time i checked. He's had the runs all evening but hes been drinking his squash fine and going for wees like normal so i'm not worryed about that side of it. Its more that he's just not him. I've been trying to get him up to give him his medicine and he just won't come round proper, eyes half open then gone again, arms like a ragdoll when i lift them. Normaly he'd be moaning at me for waking him. His mum is on nights and i dont want to ring her for nothing but this doesnt feel right to me
